# How to Use This File

Runs the Mandarin extraction from CHILDES token import through negation coding to the processed Feather export. Set the working directory to `mandarin`, install `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, then run chunks in order. Matching raw caches are reused unless `mandarin_force_download` is `TRUE`; the final file is `mandarin_data/processed_data/mandarin_tokens_processed.feather`.

# Setup

Loads the packages, sets knitr options, and creates relative raw and processed data directories.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)
library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r directories}
mandarin_db_version <- "2026.1"
mandarin_force_download <- FALSE

mandarin_data_root <- "mandarin_data"

mandarin_raw_dir <- file.path(mandarin_data_root, "raw_data")
mandarin_processed_dir <- file.path(mandarin_data_root, "processed_data")

dir.create(mandarin_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(mandarin_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

Loads the selected Mandarin corpora from CHILDES release 2026.1 or matching local caches. Validates the imported columns and cache source record before token processing.

```{r collections}
# This chunk specifies the 20 Mandarin corpora included in the data request.
mandarin_corpora_names <- c(
  "AcadLang",
  "BJCMC",
  "Chang1",
  "Chang2",
  "ChangPlay",
  "ChangPN",
  "Erbaugh",
  "LiReading",
  "LiZhou",
  "NSCtoys",
  "TCCM",
  "TCCM-reading",
  "Tong",
  "Xinjiang",
  "Zhou1",
  "Zhou2",
  "Zhou3",
  "ZhouAssessment",
  "ZhouDinner",
  "ZhouNarratives"
)
```

## Import Tokens

Loads a matching raw cache or requests tokens for the selected corpus or collection. Validates columns and row counts, then saves new raw data with its query source record.

```{r import_tokens}
# Only use caches belonging to the pinned release and the same query.
mandarin_feather_path <- file.path(mandarin_raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens.feather")
mandarin_csv_path <- file.path(mandarin_raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens.csv")
mandarin_source_info_path <- file.path(mandarin_raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens_source.rds")

mandarin_query_roles <- c("Target_Child", "Mother", "Father")
mandarin_query_info <- list(
  db_version = mandarin_db_version,
  corpus = sort(mandarin_corpora_names),
  role = sort(mandarin_query_roles),
  token = "%",
  replace = TRUE
)

mandarin_cache_info <- if (file.exists(mandarin_source_info_path)) {
  tryCatch(readRDS(mandarin_source_info_path), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

mandarin_cache_matches <- is.list(mandarin_cache_info) &&
  identical(mandarin_cache_info$query, mandarin_query_info)
mandarin_loaded_from_cache <- FALSE

if (!mandarin_force_download && mandarin_cache_matches && file.exists(mandarin_feather_path)) {
  cat(sprintf("Loading verified childes-db %s Feather cache...\n", mandarin_db_version))
  mandarin_all_tokens <- arrow::read_feather(mandarin_feather_path)
  mandarin_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else if (!mandarin_force_download && mandarin_cache_matches && file.exists(mandarin_csv_path)) {
  cat(sprintf("Loading verified childes-db %s CSV cache...\n", mandarin_db_version))
  mandarin_all_tokens <- readr::read_csv(mandarin_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  mandarin_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else {
  cat(sprintf("Downloading tokens from childes-db %s...\n", mandarin_db_version))

  mandarin_all_tokens <- childesr::get_tokens(
    corpus = mandarin_corpora_names,
    role = mandarin_query_roles,
    token = "%",
    replace = TRUE,
    db_version = mandarin_db_version
  )
}

# Avoid saving an empty/failed download or processing incompatible columns.
if (is.null(mandarin_all_tokens) || nrow(mandarin_all_tokens) == 0L) {
  stop("No tokens returned. Check the query messages and corpus names; no cache was saved.")
}

mandarin_required_columns <- c(
  "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)
mandarin_missing_columns <- setdiff(mandarin_required_columns, names(mandarin_all_tokens))
if (length(mandarin_missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop("Required columns missing: ", paste(mandarin_missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

if (mandarin_loaded_from_cache && nrow(mandarin_all_tokens) != mandarin_cache_info$row_count) {
  stop("Cache row count does not match its source record. Set mandarin_force_download <- TRUE and rerun.")
}

if (!mandarin_loaded_from_cache) {
  cat("Saving the new data and its release/query information...\n")
  arrow::write_feather(mandarin_all_tokens, mandarin_feather_path)
  readr::write_csv(mandarin_all_tokens, mandarin_csv_path)
  saveRDS(
    list(
      query = mandarin_query_info,
      downloaded_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      childesr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("childesr")),
      row_count = nrow(mandarin_all_tokens)
    ),
    mandarin_source_info_path
  )
} else if (!file.exists(mandarin_feather_path)) {
  arrow::write_feather(mandarin_all_tokens, mandarin_feather_path)
}
```

# Token Processing

Screens target-child ages, records exclusion counts, and adds speaker, completed-month age, and utterance-type labels. Builds neighboring-token context for later matching.

## Exclusions

Keeps finite target-child ages from birth to under 72 months. Counts tokens and unique child IDs, including a missing ID as one distinct value, and retains observed tokens at ages 0–10.

```{r exclusions}
mandarin_n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(mandarin_all_tokens)
mandarin_n_chi_before_exclusions <- mandarin_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_all_tokens

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  filter(is.finite(target_child_age))
mandarin_n_tokens_after_finite_age <- nrow(mandarin_tokens)
mandarin_n_chi_after_finite_age <- mandarin_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age >= 0, target_child_age < 72)
mandarin_n_tokens_after_age_range <- nrow(mandarin_tokens)
mandarin_n_chi_after_age_range <- mandarin_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

mandarin_exclusions <- tibble(
  n_tokens_before_exclusions = mandarin_n_tokens_before_exclusions,
  n_after_finite_age = mandarin_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  n_after_age_range = mandarin_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  missing_or_nonfinite_age =
    mandarin_n_tokens_before_exclusions - mandarin_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  outside_age_range =
    mandarin_n_tokens_after_finite_age - mandarin_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  n_chi_total = mandarin_n_chi_before_exclusions,
  n_chi_after_finite_age = mandarin_n_chi_after_finite_age,
  n_chi_after_age_range = mandarin_n_chi_after_age_range
)

mandarin_exclusions
```

## Save Exclusion Records

Saves the exclusion summary and retained token rows as CSV files in the raw-data directory.

```{r save_exclusions}
readr::write_csv(
  mandarin_exclusions,
  file.path(mandarin_raw_dir, "exclusions_mandarin_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  mandarin_tokens,
  file.path(mandarin_raw_dir, "mandarin_tokens_excluded.csv")
)
```

## Speaker Roles

Maps target-child roles to `child` and mother or father roles to `parent` after case normalization. Stops if a role is missing or unexpected.

```{r speaker_roles}
mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") == "target_child" ~ "child",
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") %in%
        c("mother", "father") ~ "parent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

if (anyNA(mandarin_tokens$speaker)) {
  mandarin_invalid_speaker_roles <- unique(as.character(mandarin_tokens$speaker_role[is.na(mandarin_tokens$speaker)]))
  mandarin_invalid_speaker_roles[is.na(mandarin_invalid_speaker_roles)] <- "<missing>"
  stop("Unexpected or missing speaker roles: ", paste(mandarin_invalid_speaker_roles, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Age

Calculates completed-month age by flooring the screened target-child age.

```{r age}
mandarin_tokens$age <- mandarin_tokens$target_child_age %>% floor()
```

## Utterance Types

Recodes specified question, imperative, and disrupted utterance labels; leaves unlisted labels unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
# Prepare the utterance_type categories for this study based on the utterance_types in childes-db
## Categories: declarative, imperative, interrogative, and other
mandarin_tokens$utterance_type <-
  recode(mandarin_tokens$utterance_type, 
         question = "interrogative",
         `broken for coding` = "other",
         `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
         interruption = "other",
         `interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `missing CA terminator` = "other",
         `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
         `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
         `quotation next line` = "other",
         `quotation precedes` = "other",
         `self interruption` = "other",
         `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `trail off` = "other",
         `trail off question` = "interrogative"
  )
```

## Context

Records neighboring glosses and part-of-speech tags within each utterance and initializes `word` to `nonfunction`.

```{r context}
# Keep neighboring-word context within the same transcript and utterance.
mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev2_gloss = lag(gloss, 2),
    prev_gloss = lag(gloss),
    next_gloss = lead(gloss),
    next2_gloss = lead(gloss, 2),
    prev2_pos = lag(part_of_speech, 2),
    prev_pos = lag(part_of_speech),
    next_pos = lead(part_of_speech),
    next2_pos = lead(part_of_speech, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mandarin_tokens$word <- "nonfunction"
```

# Define Target Words

Marks candidate negation, conjunction, disjunction, and conditional words using gloss, utterance type, and selected neighboring POS tags.

## Mark Target Words

Marks the listed glosses by exact match, `还是` only in interrogatives, and `跟` only when both neighboring POS tags begin with `n` or `pro`.

```{r function_words}

mandarin_function_words <- c(
  # Negation (no/not)
  "不", "不是","没", "没有",
  # Conjunction (and)
  "和", "而且",
  # Disjunction (or)
   "或者",
  # Conditionals (if)
  "如果", "要是", "的话"
)

for (x in mandarin_function_words) {
  mandarin_tokens$word[mandarin_tokens$gloss == x] <- x
}

# Only mark haishi(还是) when it occurs in an interrogative utterance (the "or" sense).
# In declarative/imperative utterances, 还是 means "still/preferably."
mandarin_tokens$word[
  mandarin_tokens$gloss == "还是" &
  mandarin_tokens$utterance_type == "interrogative"
] <- "还是"

# Only mark gen(跟) when it is likely used as a conjunction ("and"),
# i.e., flanked by nominal-type elements (nouns or pronouns) on both sides.
mandarin_tokens$word[
  mandarin_tokens$gloss == "跟" &
  str_detect(mandarin_tokens$prev_pos, "^(n|pro)") &
  str_detect(mandarin_tokens$next_pos, "^(n|pro)")
] <- "跟"
```

## Word Categories

Assigns matched words to their lexical function categories; leaves unmatched tokens as `nonfunction`.

```{r wordcategories}
mandarin_tokens$word_category <- "nonfunction"

mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("不","不是","没", "没有")] <- "Negation"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("和", "跟", "而且")] <- "Conjunction"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("或者", "还是")] <- "Disjunction"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("如果", "要是", "的话")] <- "Conditionals"
```

## Syntactic Category

Labels identified function words `Function` and other tokens `nonfunction`.

```{r syncategory}
mandarin_tokens$syncategory <- "Function"
mandarin_tokens$syncategory[mandarin_tokens$word_category == "nonfunction"] <- "nonfunction"
```

# Negation Word Normalization

Normalizes split and unsplit negators, clears recognized question patterns, and flags excluded non-negation structures while retaining their rows.

## Normalize Negators

Codes `不`, `不是`, `没`, and `没有`, treating adjacent split forms as one expression on the first token. Clears negation labels from continuation tokens and recognized `是不是` patterns.

```{r negation_clean}
mandarin_negation_levels <- c("不", "不是", "没", "没有")

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_adj = coalesce(token_order - lag(token_order) == 1, FALSE),
    next_adj = coalesce(lead(token_order) - token_order == 1, FALSE),

    is_split_start = (gloss == "不" & next_adj & next_gloss == "是") |
                      (gloss == "没" & next_adj & next_gloss == "有"),

    negation_is_continuation = coalesce(lag(is_split_start) & prev_adj, FALSE),

    is_shi_bu_shi = gloss == "是不是" |
      (gloss == "不是" & prev_adj & prev_gloss == "是") |
      (gloss == "不"   & prev_adj & prev_gloss == "是" & next_adj & next_gloss == "是"),

    negation_category = case_when(
      is_shi_bu_shi | negation_is_continuation ~ NA_character_,
      gloss == "不是" | (gloss == "不" & is_split_start) ~ "不是",
      gloss == "没有" | (gloss == "没" & is_split_start) ~ "没有",
      gloss == "不" ~ "不",
      gloss == "没" ~ "没",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    word = case_when(
      negation_is_continuation ~ "nonfunction",
      !is.na(negation_category) ~ negation_category,
      word %in% mandarin_negation_levels | word_category == "Negation" ~ "nonfunction",
      TRUE ~ coalesce(as.character(word), "nonfunction")
    ),
    word_category = case_when(
      word %in% mandarin_negation_levels ~ "Negation",
      word %in% c("和", "跟", "而且") ~ "Conjunction",
      word %in% c("或者", "还是") ~ "Disjunction",
      word %in% c("如果", "要是", "的话") ~ "Conditionals",
      TRUE ~ "nonfunction"
    ),
    syncategory = if_else(word_category == "nonfunction", "nonfunction", "Function")
  ) %>%
  
  select(-prev_adj, -next_adj, -is_split_start, -is_shi_bu_shi, -negation_is_continuation)
```

## Exclude Non-negation Structures

Flags adjacent A-not-A patterns and utterance-final negative alternatives, clearing their function-word labels while preserving diagnostic exclusion reasons.

```{r negation_remove_nonnegation}

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_adj = coalesce(token_order - lag(token_order) == 1, FALSE),
    next_adj = coalesce(lead(token_order) - token_order == 1, FALSE),
    
    is_end = is.na(next_gloss) |
      coalesce(
        next_adj &
        (
          (gloss == "不" & next_gloss == "是") |
          (gloss == "没" & next_gloss == "有")
        ) &
        is.na(next2_gloss),
      FALSE
    ),

    negation_exclusion = case_when(
      is.na(negation_category) ~ NA_character_,
      # A_not_A format
      prev_adj & next_adj & (
        (gloss %in% c("不", "没") & (prev_gloss == next_gloss | startsWith(next_gloss, prev_gloss))) |
        (gloss == "不是" & prev_gloss == "是") |
        (gloss == "没有" & prev_gloss == "有")
      ) ~ "A_not_A",
      
      # Utterance-final negative alternative in a question.
      prev_adj & is_end & (
        coalesce(utterance_type == "interrogative", FALSE) |
        prev_gloss %in% c("了", "过", "好", "完")
      ) ~ "final_alternative_question",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    word          = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", word),
    word_category = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", word_category),
    syncategory   = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", syncategory)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-prev_adj, -next_adj, -is_end)
```

# Sentential vs. Discourse Negation

Assigns scope after exclusions using manual case-ID overrides, utterance-initial discourse patterns, and POS-based sentential rules. Leaves unmatched eligible negators `uncertain` and displays counts by negator and scope.

```{r negation_categorization}
mandarin_manual_negation_scope <- character(0)

mandarin_pure_discourse_particles <- c(
  "啊", "呀", "吧", "呢", "啦", "哦", "哈",
  "哇", "呗", "嘛", "哼", "哎", "么", "哩"
)

if (
  length(mandarin_manual_negation_scope) > 0 &&
  (
    is.null(names(mandarin_manual_negation_scope)) ||
    any(names(mandarin_manual_negation_scope) == "") ||
    anyDuplicated(names(mandarin_manual_negation_scope)) > 0 ||
    !all(mandarin_manual_negation_scope %in%
           c("sentential", "discourse", "uncertain"))
  )
) {
  stop("Manual negation-scope codes must have unique case IDs and valid labels.")
}

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    .case_id = str_c(
      transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order,
      sep = "|"
    ),

    .is_split = coalesce(
      (gloss == "不" & next_gloss == "是") |
        (gloss == "没" & next_gloss == "有"),
      FALSE
    ),
    
    .target_next_pos = toupper(trimws(coalesce(
      if_else(.is_split, next2_pos, next_pos), ""
    ))),

    .target_next_gloss = if_else(
      .is_split, next2_gloss, next_gloss
    ),

    .prev_pos_upper = toupper(
      trimws(coalesce(prev_pos, ""))
    ),

    .current_pos_upper = toupper(trimws(coalesce(part_of_speech, ""))),

    .is_utt_start = is.na(prev_gloss) | prev_gloss == "",

    .has_prev_context = .prev_pos_upper %in%
      c("NOUN", "PRON", "PROPN", "DET", "ADP"),

    .tail_token_ok =
      .current_pos_upper %in% c("PUNCT", "INTJ", "SFP") |
      gloss %in% mandarin_pure_discourse_particles |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(gloss, ""),
        "^[，。！？、；：,.!?;:…]+$"
      ),

    .tail_all_clean = rev(cumall(rev(.tail_token_ok))),

    .is_standalone = .is_utt_start &
      if_else(
        .is_split,
        is.na(next2_gloss) | next2_gloss == "",
        is.na(next_gloss) | next_gloss == ""
      ),

    .is_pure_discourse_response = .is_utt_start &
      if_else(
        .is_split,
        coalesce(lead(.tail_all_clean, 2L), FALSE),
        coalesce(lead(.tail_all_clean), FALSE)
      ),

    .is_turn_initial_discourse = .is_utt_start &
      (
        .target_next_pos == "PUNCT" |
          str_detect(
            coalesce(.target_next_gloss, ""),
            "^[，。！？、；：,.!?;:…]+$"
          )
      ),

    negation_scope = case_when(

  is.na(negation_category) |
    !is.na(negation_exclusion) ~ NA_character_,

  .case_id %in% names(mandarin_manual_negation_scope) ~
    unname(mandarin_manual_negation_scope[.case_id]),

  .is_standalone |
    .is_pure_discourse_response |
    .is_turn_initial_discourse ~ "discourse",

  negation_category %in% c("不", "没") &
    .target_next_pos %in%
      c("VERB", "AUX", "ADJ", "ADV", "ADP", "SCONJ") ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category %in% c("没", "没有", "不是") &
    .target_next_pos %in%
      c("NOUN", "PRON", "PROPN", "NUM", "DET", "N:LET", "L2") ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category %in% c("不是", "没有") &
    (
      .has_prev_context |
        .target_next_pos %in%
          c("VERB", "AUX", "ADJ", "ADV", "ADP", "SCONJ")
    ) ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category == "没" &
    .has_prev_context &
    (
      is.na(.target_next_gloss) |
        .target_next_gloss == "" |
        .target_next_pos %in% c("PUNCT", "SFP") |
        .target_next_gloss %in% mandarin_pure_discourse_particles
    ) ~
    "sentential",

  TRUE ~ "uncertain"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-starts_with("."))

mandarin_negation_scope_counts_step3 <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  filter(!is.na(negation_scope)) %>%
  count(negation_category, negation_scope, name = "count") %>%
  complete(
    negation_category = mandarin_negation_levels,
    negation_scope = c("sentential", "discourse", "uncertain"),
    fill = list(count = 0L)
  )
mandarin_negation_scope_counts_step3
```

# Save Processed Data

Saves the annotated token table to `mandarin_data/processed_data/mandarin_tokens_processed.feather`.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(
  mandarin_tokens,
  file.path(mandarin_processed_dir, "mandarin_tokens_processed.feather")
)
```
